evaluator_used.usage_note: Called once per physical point (n-mH=1, n-M2=1 grids) via subprocess; no source modification.
evaluator_used.verification: Benchmark point (mH=150, tan_beta=3e5, M2=22499.9999995) reproduced theory_ok_v1=1, g_hH2H2=63.59142520075966 GeV, matching results/presentation_update/points.csv benchmark row.

model_contract.note: M2 != m12_sq; m12_sq = M2*sin(beta)*cos(beta). mH held fixed at the benchmark value throughout this campaign (Region I: mH < 2*mh).

no_madgraph_run_reason: Phase A stop condition triggered: both tested fixed-mass axes (M2/tan_beta, lambda6) produced g_hH2H2 variation 6-13 orders of magnitude below the ~0.7% MadGraph MC-statistical floor. Per mission Section 7, an expensive MadGraph campaign was not forced.

phases_executed.description: Fixed mH=150 GeV, logarithmic tan_beta scan (1e4-1e6 primary + 3e6/9e6 diagnostic, ceiling 1e7 not exceeded). At each tan_beta: Newton-corrected M2 center (lambda1_reconstructed=1, analytic slope -tan_beta^2/v^2, oracle = evaluator's own output, no cross-evaluator mixing) then bisected theory_ok_v1 window edges in M2.
phases_executed.n_evaluator_calls: ~800 (13 tan_beta points x ~60 bisection/Newton calls each)
phases_executed.key_finding: Theory-valid M2 window: 2.5e-3 GeV^2 (tan_beta=1e4) down to 2.8e-6 GeV^2 (tan_beta=3e5). Max |delta_g/g| in window: 2.5e-7 down to 2.7e-10.

phases_executed.description: lambda6 axis sweep at fixed mH=150, tan_beta=3e5, M2=manifold center (22499.999999500335). Benchmark value 1e-10 plus decades both signs to |lambda6|=10 ceiling; theory-valid boundary bisected.
phases_executed.key_finding: Theory-valid lambda6 window: [-7.086098e-06, +2.222324e-06] (bisected). g_hH2H2 varies by ~1.07e-14 relative across the entire accepted range -- indistinguishable from evaluator floating-point noise.

phases_executed.description: Consolidation of the previous campaign's mH=130/150/170 result (no rerun) into a compact PI-facing table.
Bounded probe of the existing environment for a functional Pythia8/shower route (no build-from-source).

phase_b_skip_justification: Per Section 7/8 stop-gate: fewer than 3 useful theory-valid points spanning a meaningful range in |g_hH2H2| exist at fixed mH=150 (max spread found: 1e-7 to 1e-14 relative, far below the 'few percent' threshold). fixed_mass_g2_test.csv and sigma_normalized_vs_g2_fixed_mass.{png,pdf} were therefore not produced.

recast_gate.note: Unchanged from the prior campaign (results/presentation_update/README.md section 5): mH axis changes both normalization and H2 boost shape simultaneously; candidates mH=130/170 already have MadGraph events on disk. Still blocked on Pythia8 (see pythia_probe.md).
